notes.title: Subaeria is launching on April 24th
notes.content:
To all residents of Subaeria !

We’re glad to announce that the game is leaping out of Early Access on April 24th, at the revised price of $14.99 USD. 

Here are the latest improvements we’ve been working on :
Level art polish
Faster loading time
Achievements updates
Overall framerate improvements
Overall VFX Polish
Updated ocean visuals 
Various fixes (Quests, unlocks, apps, etc...)
Balanced economy
Added languages support (English, French, Italian, Spanish, Portuguese)
Updated sounds/music

On April 24, you’ll also be able to visit Subaeria on PS4 and Xbox One!

We can’t wait to see you explore the depths of Subaeria in this latest release!

notes.title: A long overdue update
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 

It’s been awhile since we updated this page, but we’re still around and working on Subaeria. This is the biggest update we’ve done in a while, so we won’t be listing all the details, but here are the main features and changes that have been made: 

[list]    
[*]Revamped the game story to have something more streamlined and 
  accessible 
[*]Fixed a shovel load of bugs and issues
[*]Optimized the game to get it to run smoother on most machines
[*]Added new story missions and labyrinths
[/list]

We’re also staying loyal to our Montréal roots, and now have the game localised in French for you guys, with Italian, Portuguese, German and Spanish coming down the pipeline soon. 

We also have a major announcement for Subaeria that will be coming in January, so stay tuned! 


We will be updating the game more frequently over the next few months, with our planned full release happening in March 2018 (for real). We’ll mainly be fixing bugs and tweaking according to your feedback.  As usual, we’re looking forward to getting your feedback on this and answering all your questions. 


Happy playing! 

The iLLOGIKA Team

notes.title: Patch 1.2 is now live!
notes.content:
Hi!

We've just launched our second patch for Subaeria. We're continually improving the game, so drop us som feedback on these changes. 

Here's a list of everything that's been updated, feel free to reach out through the forums if you have any questions! 

Released 19/11/2015

[h1]GENERAL[/h1]


[u]Mouse and Keyboard support[/u]
[list]
	[*]Added Mouse and Keyboard support in Drone menu.
[/list]

[u]Optimization[/u]
[list]
	[*]Fixed an issue causing lag spikes near the Hermes' entrance door.
[/list]

[h1]AI[/h1]

[u]Bosses[/u]
[list]
	[*] Fixed an issue preventing Soma enemies from being destroyed after defeating JoeBlow, resulting in player's death during the cinematic.
[/list]
[u]Behavior[/u]
[list]
	[*]Fixed an issue increasing the enemies' detection range when they are close to each other.
	[*]Fixed an issue forcing an animation on defeated Iron enemies.
	[*]Fixed an issue deactivating floor sanitizers in uncleared rooms.
[/list]

[h1]ART[/h1]

[u]Models[/u]
[list]
    [*] Polish on destructible crates.
[/list]

notes.title: Content release #1
notes.content:
Hi!

We’ve just released our first Early Access content update for Subaeria. Hurray!

This update adds Antonio as a playable character. He’s a venerable hacker who’s story will take you to new locales in Subaeria and give you a better look at how the underwater city functions. We’ve also added a new environment for you to explore, the Community, where the wealthy Subaerian elites live. There are new environmental hazards (the Hermes train whizzing through rooms) and room patterns, a revamp of the Big Saw and much more! 

Here's a list of everything that's been updated, feel free to reach out through the forums if you have any questions! 

Released 04/11/2015

[h1]ART[/h1]

[u]Main Menu[/u]
[list]
    [*] New visual for main menu.
    [*] New mouse pointer design.
[/list]

[u]Level Art[/u]
[list]
    [*] Polished playable environment: Community.
    [*] New visuals for the surface environment.
    [*] Light indicators for clean vs hostile rooms has been modified, clean rooms are now green and hostile are red.
[/list]

[u]UI[/u]
[list]
    [*] New Area of Effect visual feedback for Floor Sanitizers.
[/list]

[u]Models[/u]
[list]
[*] New visual for Big Saw.
[*] New collectible currency design.
[*] New textures for dynamic crates.
[/list]

[h1]AI[/h1]

[u]Behavior[/u]
[list]
[*] Big Saws will now try to destroy objects blocking their way, and teleport back to their starting point if unsuccessful after 2 tries.
[/list]

[u]Physics[/u]
[list]
[*] Big Saws are more efficient at moving crates out of the way.
[*] Collectible currency attraction range has been upgraded.
[/list]

[h1]NARRATIVE[/h1]

[u]Characters[/u]
[list]
    [*] New playable character: Antonio
[/list]

[u]Quests[/u]
[list]
    [*] New endings for Antonio and Styx
    [*] New playable labyrinth: Community
[/list]

[h1]LEVEL DESIGN[/h1]

[u]Room Hazards[/u]
[list]
    [*] Most room hazards now shut down when a room is cleared of enemies.
    [*] New hazard, the Hermes, can be found in Management Ward and Stockpile District.
[/list]

[u]Room patterns[/u]
[list]
    [*] New room variations from security level 1 to 7.
[/list]

[h1]SOUND[/h1]

[u]Music[/u]
[list]
    [*] New music track for Community.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.1 has launched!
notes.content:
Hi everyone, we released our first patch for Subaeria yesterday evening.

Here's a list of everything that's been updated, feel free to reach out through the forums if you have any questions! 

Released 10/22/2015

[h1]GENERAL[/h1]

[u]Optimization[/u]
	[list]
	[*] Improved loading times.
	[*] Fixed an issue causing lag spikes near room gates.
[/list]

[u]Mouse and Keyboard support[/u]
[list]
	[*] Added Mouse navigation in the main menu.
	[*]Key indicators added for M/KB users.
[/list]

[h1]ART[/h1]

[u]User interface[/u]
[list]
	[*] New UI visuals for the drone's area of effect.
	[*] New map and mini-map indicators.
	[*] App information can be displayed when in pick-up range.
	[*] Sniff acquisition progress bar added to the HUD.
	[*] Sniff information updated when purchasing in shops.
	[*] Fixed issue causing the Sniff or App's name to be displayed incorrectly in the in-game menu.
[/list]

[u]VFX[/u]
[list]
	[*] Fixed a visual corruption issue on the drone's trail when using Apps.
	[*] New VFX indicating Big Cleaners taking a hit & damaged state.
	[*] New water surface for the Community environment.
	[*] Fixed issue where area damage isn't displayed properly by the VFX.
	[*] New VFX for freeze traps.
[/list]

[u]Level Art[/u]
[list]
	[*] Fixed various issues regarding floating objects in certain rooms.
	[*] Fixed various issues regarding possible exploits or blockers in certain rooms.
[/list]
[h1]NARRATIVE[/h1]

[u]Quests[/u]
[list]
	[*] Fixed an issue preventing the RisingSun squat from being unlocked.
	[*] Fixed an issue resetting cut-scenes in the Hermes to Storages room.
	[*] Fixed an issue where the cut-scenes are not triggered.
	[*] Various localisation fixes and polish.
[/list]
[h1]LEVEL DESIGN[/h1]

[u]Enemies[/u]
[list]
	[*] Fixed an issue where Iron enemies' animation doesn't stop after the room has been cleared.
	[*] Fixed an issue cancelling grenade damage to other enemies.
	[*] Fixed an issue where the character would be briefly stopped when taking grenade damage.
[/list]
[u]Room patterns[/u]
[list]
	[*] General polish on critical room patterns.
[/list]
[h1]SOUND[/h1]

[u]Music[/u]
[list]
	[*] Fixed issues preventing the music from being triggered in certain rooms.
[/list]

[u]SFX[/u]
[list]
	[*] Various bug fixes and polish.
[/list]

notes.title: October Update
notes.content:
Hi fellow Subaerians! 

A week after launch, we’re taking a minute to let you guys know where the game is going and what we’ll be adding/fixing over the next month. We’ll be doing monthly content updates, as well as sporadic patches and fixes, as we implement and test them. 

Here’s what you can expect to be added to the game during the month of October: 
[list]
[*] Extra character: Antonio is joining the fray! His story will give a better perspective on Subaerian society and allow you to explore more of the underwater city.
[*]New environment: The Community (which you briefly saw if you played the tutorial) will be playable in-game at higher security levels.  
[*]Plenty of bug fixing and polishing of the game. We’re taking all your suggestions really seriously and will fix and polish the game accordingly. 
[/list]
Reach out to us with any questions or recommendations, we’re always listening.
